categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. operates primarily in four business segments: electronic circuit products (including flexible printed circuit boards, rigid printed circuit boards, and rigid-flex boards), precision components (mainly precision metal structural parts for new energy vehicles and communication equipment), touch display modules (touch panels and LCD modules for consumer electronics and automotive applications), and LED display devices (small-pitch LED and Mini LED packaging products).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as high-density interconnect (HDI) PCB fabrication, precision metal stamping, die-casting, sheet metal processing, and precision machining. It emphasizes R&D in new materials, high-frequency and high-speed transmission lines, encapsulation technologies for LED devices, and integrated touch-display module assembly. The company also advances intelligent manufacturing through digitalization and smart factory initiatives.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global enterprises in consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, communication equipment, industrial control, AI, and medical devices. The company serves major smartphone manufacturers, automotive OEMs focusing on electric vehicles, and communication infrastructure providers. Its products are integral to smartphones, tablets, laptops, smartwatches, automotive displays, and industrial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with headquarters and multiple manufacturing bases in Suzhou, Yancheng, and other cities. It has expanded internationally through subsidiaries and acquisitions in Hong Kong, the United States, Mexico, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Sweden, Germany, and Mauritius, supporting global sales and localized production.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dongshan Precision operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing core components such as PCBs, precision metal parts, touch display modules, and LED devices. It acts as a key supplier to downstream OEMs and system integrators in consumer electronics and automotive sectors, providing integrated component solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on dual-core growth engines: consumer electronics and new energy vehicles. It prioritizes R&D in advanced flexible circuit technologies, high-frequency PCBs, Mini LED displays, automotive-grade touch modules, and precision metal components for EVs. Investments in intelligent manufacturing, digital transformation, and global production capacity expansion are strategic priorities to enhance competitiveness and meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of electronic circuits, precision components, touch display modules, and LED devices. The company operates on an order-driven production model, fulfilling customized customer orders with integrated manufacturing and assembly services. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dongshan Precision ranks among the top global manufacturers in flexible printed circuit boards (second globally) and PCBs (third globally). It is a leading supplier in China for precision metal components and touch display modules. The company competes with other major PCB and electronic component manufacturers worldwide, leveraging its integrated product offerings and global footprint to maintain a strong market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 33.65 billion, representing a 6.56% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 1.96 billion, a 17.05% decrease compared to the previous year. The company has total assets exceeding RMB 44 billion and net assets over RMB 18 billion, with steady cash flow growth and ongoing investments in capacity expansion and acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dongshan Precision emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop integrated solutions across electronic circuits, precision metal parts, and display modules, catering to high-tech and rapidly evolving industries. Its competitive advantages include advanced technology, strong R&D capabilities, large-scale production capacity, and close collaboration with leading global customers. The company’s ability to provide customized, high-quality, and innovative core components supports customers’ product performance and market competitiveness.
